title: Twelve-month operating-expense reforecast
prompt:
Reforecast July 2026 through June 2027 operating expense by function.

Begin with the July FY27 planning thread in `Requests/`, including the controller's follow-up after the first steering review. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: identify the current controller-tied workpapers, retain prior versions only for comparison, and resolve source authority from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Several nearby files are earlier working versions or belong to a different reporting purpose. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Recompute the analysis from the shared company sources and do not rely on a deliverable produced by another task.

Combine June run rate, approved hires and termination dates, contracted step-ups, one-time items, and documented savings. Exclude depreciation and interest from controllable opex. Calculate the revised twelve-month total, variance to the approved plan, and the three largest unfavorable function variances. A delayed hire affects only months after the revised start date.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `reforecast_opex`, `plan_opex`, `opex_variance`, `largest_unfavorable_functions`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
